build_gtn_python_package: build the gtn python package with cmake extensions for graph transducer networks
build_cmake_extension: build a CMakeExtension for gtn modules like _graph _autograd _utils _rand _creations _functions _parallel
run_cmake_build: run the CMakeBuild command to compile gtn C++ extensions using cmake version 3.5.1 or higher
build_gtn_extension: build a single gtn extension module by invoking cmake with GTN_BUILD_PYTHON_BINDINGS enabled
load_readme_description: load the README.md file and return its contents as the long description for the gtn package
